title: Pissed Off Bastards of Bloomington
reason: Subject not confirmed beyond one opened page, and no reference-supported history of the club. Subject: the title names a California outlaw motorcycle club from Bloomington, Calif.; the pages opened (Austin Chronicle, 2006) name the club only in passing as one of the parties to the 1947 Hollister rally brawl, with Boozefighters. Jalopnik, Cutler and Gross, American Heritage, Los Angeles Times (2015) and the San Francisco Chronicle transcription name the Boozefighters, Gypsy Tour riders and Life magazine photo, but not this club. The club's founding (1945), membership, chapters and later history appear only in Wikipedia and a mirror-type site (Grokipedia), which cannot support facts or be cited. Writing 1,000 real words would mean filling most of the article with Hollister events about other clubs, which would misrepresent the subject. Tried: 6 WebSearch queries (club name, POBOB history, Hollister 1947, Boozefighters, court or charge searches), Wikipedia lead and its cited pages (LA Times and cestcop opened; Time, Nova IJMS, Buffalo News, SFGate failed or thin). Needs: a source on the club itself (its history, chapters, or its own press coverage), or a decision from the owner to retitle as the 1947 Hollister rally.
